title: mplementation of a Multimodal Machine Perfusion Program in Liver Transplantation: A Real-World Analysis of Clinical Outcomes, Logistics, and Resource Use in a European High-Volume Center
summary: To investigate whether machine perfusion of donor livers prior to liver transplantation improves clinical outcomes, workflow processes, and resource utilization compared with conventional static cold storage.
conditions: Liver disorders in diseases classified elsewhere
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
all performed liver transplantations
Exclusion criteria:
none
